providers.name: AllAnime
providers.description: AniList-mapped AllAnime GraphQL provider. Includes encrypted episode-response handling (QuickJS WebCrypto AES-GCM required), internal clock endpoint and direct HLS/MP4 extraction. External embed pages are only returned when a direct media URL is visible.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw

providers.name: Anikage
providers.description: AniList-mapped Anikage API provider with episode/server/source requests, Koto/Rai server discovery, public stream-proxy token resolution, HLS variant parsing and subtitle tracks.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw

providers.name: Anikoto
providers.description: AniList-mapped Anikoto multisource provider with episode/server AJAX requests, public mapper fallback, direct HLS and MegaPlay source parsing. Signed CDN token creation and browser challenges are not emulated.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw

providers.name: AniLight
providers.description: AniList-ID-mapped AniLight API provider with episode lookup, public MegaPlay embed parsing, AES-CBC source decryption, HLS quality parsing and subtitle tracks. Other WebView/Turnstile-only server routes require a native browser host capability.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw

providers.name: Miruro
providers.description: AniList-mapped Miruro secure-pipe provider. Resolves exact episode/provider/subtype records, decodes the pipe response, and emits observed direct HLS streams with Miruro relay URLs and real subtitle tracks. Uses ordinary HTTP requests; browser verification and Android-only embed extractors are not emulated.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw

providers.description: AniList-mapped AniChan episode/server API port with observed direct HLS/MP4 candidates and subtitle tracks.
providers.author: Unfiltered Raw
